queer_characters.name: Marc Borgmann
queer_characters.notes: Described as a bisexual police officer discovering same-sex attraction while in a relationship with a woman; treated seriously but the narrative centers on an affair and ends with him isolated, which reads as melancholic/cautionary rather than affirming.
queer_characters.contest_notes: Source text notes some may read the isolated, affair-centered ending as cautionary or tragic representation rather than a clean happy ending; his identity struggle leaves the specific label open to interpretation.

queer_characters.name: Kay Engel
